name: jcsl-tools
description: Josh C.S. Lewis's personal AI tooling — implementation workflow parties and skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: kiln
plugins.description: Complexity-proportionate implementation Party — a thin conductor dispatches Planner, Crafter, Inspector, and Walker members, enforcing gates via PreToolUse hooks. Invoke with /kiln.

plugins.name: gauntlet
plugins.description: Multi-skill AI review harness — orchestrates adversarial, security, directive, doc, plan, and skill-audit review lanes. Invoke with /gauntlet. Includes the v2 pilot lanes gauntlet2-adversarial-review and gauntlet2-code-quality-audit (explicit invocation only).

plugins.name: prospector
plugins.description: Discovery-first research harness — finds where an answer lives across Glean, GitHub, Jira, and the web, verifies every load-bearing claim, and synthesizes a cited answer. Invoke with /prospector:research.

plugins.name: context-economy
plugins.description: Context Economy Party — Steward, Assembler, Delegator, Chronicler, Observer skills plus telemetry + a boundary-gated mid-session handoff nudge for spending Claude Code context economically. Invoke via the context-economy skill.

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Repository cartographer — analyzes a repo's structure and evidence to draft a grounded, claim-classified README enrichment, flagging unsupported claims and stale content. Invoke via the cartograph-report skill.
